# GridEditor

```csharp
public sealed class GridEditor
```

Namespace `SharpCell.Grid` · package `SharpCell.Grid`

Changes a workbook's cells as people change them in Excel: typing into cells, Delete, pasting text copied from Excel. Each change is one step to undo and redo, and the workbook is recalculated after it. What is typed is read as Excel reads it, through `Cell.Input`. Only the cells' content is kept for undoing: values, formulas and number formats, not styles.

## Methods

<a id="clear-worksheet-cellarea"></a>
### Clear(Worksheet, CellArea)

```csharp
public GridEdit Clear(Worksheet sheet, CellArea area)
```

Clears the content of the cells in an area, as Delete does: values and formulas go, number formats and styles stay.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: A cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell; no cell changes.

<a id="clearhistory"></a>
### ClearHistory()

```csharp
public void ClearHistory()
```

Forgets every change, so that none can be undone, as after a workbook is replaced.

<a id="enter-worksheet-cellarea-string"></a>
### Enter(Worksheet, CellArea, string)

```csharp
public GridEdit Enter(Worksheet sheet, CellArea area, string input)
```

Types the same text into every cell of an area, as Enter does for one cell and Ctrl+Enter for a selection. Inside a merged area only its top-left cell takes the text.

**Exceptions**

- `FormulaParseException`: The text starts with `=` but is not a formula; no cell changes.
- `InvalidOperationException`: A cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell; no cell changes.

<a id="move-worksheet-cellarea-cellposition"></a>
### Move(Worksheet, CellArea, CellPosition)

```csharp
public GridEdit Move(Worksheet sheet, CellArea from, CellPosition to)
```

Moves cells, as cutting and pasting them in Excel does: their values or formulas and number formats go to the area with its top-left cell at `to`, and the cells left behind are cleared. Formulas move as they are written; what lies beyond the sheet's edge is left out. Styles stay where they were.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: A cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell; no cell changes.

<a id="paste-worksheet-cellposition-string"></a>
### Paste(Worksheet, CellPosition, string)

```csharp
public GridEdit Paste(Worksheet sheet, CellPosition at, string text)
```

Pastes text copied from Excel or another program with its top-left cell at a cell: tabs between cells, line breaks between rows, cells with line breaks in double quotes. Each cell is read as typed; an empty one clears its cell. What lies beyond the sheet's edge is left out.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidOperationException`: A cell is part of an array formula other than its top-left cell; no cell changes.
